next.reason: Both relate an alphabet-name to a code set and/or collating sequence by the context that references it, and NATIVE names the native set and sequence (§2023:12.3.7.4 GR7 NOTE 2, Table 6, d)). Differs: 1985 'If the STANDARD-2 phrase is specified, the character code set identified is the International Reference Version of the ISO 7-bit code'; §2023:12.3.7.4 GR7 c): 'the implementor shall specify whether the International Reference Version or a national version is referenced'. STANDARD-1 moves from ANSI X3.4-1977 to 'ISO/IEC 646 International Reference Version', and the collating sequence of both is the ISO/IEC 646 order.
